content.short: Bumper Finance protects the value of your crypto with a radically innovative DeFi protocol.
content.description: Traditional hedging tools, such as options, are often complex and costly, and they don't translate well to blockchain environments. Bumper uses DeFi to simplify risk management, making it easier, cheaper, and more efficient to protect assets. You choose the price you want to defend, and if markets move against you, your holdings won’t fall below that level. In short, Bumper provides accessible protection against adverse price moves without the friction of traditional hedging.
